goal: Coordinate competitive World responses across SummonScout clients so one competitor event produces at most one fleet advert, using master heartbeats and fail-silent grant arbitration without changing customer summon flows.
notes: Cold FleetCounterCoordinator.lua stays outside *Hot.lua fanout. FCV/FCE heartbeats establish fresh coordinator capability; FCC candidate collection is master-arbitrated; FCG is a single commit grant; FCA is observability only and never causes retry/reassignment. Initial activation requires 4/4 fresh service coverage and 4 distinct service-owning coordinator clients. Group price is master-owned. CompetitionSmart falls back to legacy local scheduling only when no fresh/recent fleet capability exists.
